questions.stem:
Passage: Many engineering students spend their first two years almost entirely in classrooms. They solve equations on paper and watch demonstrations on screens, but rarely touch the machines their textbooks describe. A growing number of teachers argue that this order should be reversed. When students are asked to repair a simple circuit before they fully understand the theory behind it, they tend to pay closer attention in the following lectures: the broken device gives every formula a purpose. Critics worry that early practice without theory produces guesswork rather than understanding. The evidence, however, suggests that the two reinforce each other when practice comes first. Students who struggled with a real circuit were far more likely to ask why a formula works, not merely how to apply it.

Question: What does the passage suggest about the order of theory and practice?
options: Practice should come before theory in the early years of engineering study.
Theory should be mastered completely before any practical work begins.
Practical work is only useful after students have passed basic exams.
The two should be kept strictly separate to avoid confusion.
questions.analysis: 首段提出「教师主张把顺序颠倒」——先修电路再学理论；后文 even 句给出支持证据（先动手的学生更爱问为什么）。A 是对首句与末句的归纳。B 与原文相反；C 无依据（文中没提考试）；D 与「相互强化」矛盾。
questions.traps: 易被 Critics worry… 干扰成「先实践不可取」，但作者随即用 The evidence, however, 反转到支持实践先行，注意 however 后的立场才是作者立场。

questions.stem: （承接上篇）Question: Why do students who first repair a circuit ask better questions afterwards?
options: Because they have memorized more formulas than their classmates.
Because the real device makes the purpose of each formula concrete.
Because they are afraid of failing the following lectures.
Because their teachers give them higher marks for practice.
questions.analysis: 原文关键句：the broken device gives every formula a purpose（坏掉的器件让每个公式有了用途），B 是其同义改写（makes the purpose concrete）。A 与原文「更愿意问为什么」的方向相反；C、D 文中均未提及。
questions.traps: 典型「同义替换」题：purpose → concrete purpose。不要因为 A 出现 formulas 就选 A，注意逻辑方向是「少背公式、多问原因」。

questions.stem: Directions: Write an essay on the importance of hands-on practice in engineering learning. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
questions.answer:
参考范文（原创）：
Hands-on practice matters because engineering is judged by results, not by intentions. A student who has wired a circuit knows what a loose contact feels like; a student who has only read about it does not. Practice also changes how theory is learned. When a device fails, the failure points directly at the concept the student has misunderstood, which makes the following lecture feel like an answer rather than a lecture.
Admittedly, practice without guidance can waste time. The solution is not to postpone practice until theory is complete, but to pair each experiment with a short explanation. In this way students build both confidence and understanding.
For these reasons, I believe every engineering course should include at least one task in which students build, test and repair something real.
questions.analysis: 评分看四点：①立场明确（首段即表态）②论证有层次（个人经验→学习机制→让步反驳）③衔接词自然（because / also / admittedly / for these reasons）④语言准确（时态统一、无中式表达）。范文用「具体细节」替代空话（a loose contact feels like）是拿高分的关键。
questions.traps: 常见失分：只喊口号（Practice makes perfect）不给机制；通篇简单句；字数不足 120。建议每段一个核心机制 + 一个例子。

questions.stem:
将下面一段话译成英文：
中国的高铁网络是世界上最繁忙的铁路系统之一。它把许多中小城市与大都市连接起来，使人们可以在一天之内往返于相距千里的两地。高铁不仅缩短了出行时间，也改变了人们选择工作与居住地的方式。
questions.answer:
参考译文（原创）：
China's high-speed rail network is one of the busiest railway systems in the world. It connects many small and medium-sized cities with major metropolises, enabling people to travel between places a thousand kilometers apart and return within a single day. High-speed rail has not only shortened travel time but also changed the way people choose where to work and live.
questions.analysis: 三个采分点：①「世界上最繁忙的之一」→ one of the busiest … in the world（最高级 + of 结构）②「使人们可以……往返」→ enabling people to … and return（分词作结果状语，比 so that 更简洁）③「不仅……也……」→ not only … but also …（注意 not only 置于句首时才倒装，此处不倒装）。
questions.traps: 易错：「相距千里」不要直译 thousand miles apart（千里≈500 km，用 a thousand kilometers apart 更稳）；「中小城市」medium-sized 不能漏 sized；时态用现在完成时更贴切（has shortened / has changed）。
